messages:
Taylor (Sales): FYI — Orion sent a Trust Framework RFI this morning. They want our capability matrix, answers on KMS/HSM, data residency, and a sample POC SOW. Can SE/security help collate?
Alex (SE): on it. Do we have an existing matrix we can fork for 'trust-framework' or should I start fresh?
Priya (Security): I can draft the security Q&A. Key asks to cover: KMS key ownership, BYOK options, HSM integrations, audit logs retention, FedRAMP/GDPR posture.
Taylor (Sales): pls include our default answers + where Dedicated/Private differ. They asked for confirmation about customer-managed KMS and on-prem HSM attachments.
Alex (SE): I'll pull the capability matrix. Quick Q — do we offer HSM-backed private key storage in Private today or is that on roadmap?
Priya (Security): Private supports KMS integration (we have KMS connectors for AWS/Azure/GCP). On-prem HSM is supported via our Private on-prem package with HSM passthrough — must add note about SOC2 & audit steps.
Jordan (Product): Add the caveat: on-prem HSM requires a support runbook and a 2–4 week validation window. Also note that dedicated (hosted) cannot attach customer HSMs — only KMS via customer-managed keys in supported clouds.
Sam (Pricing): For the POC SOW — pricing options: 1) short eval on Hosted (metred) — free credits; 2) Dedicated trial (1 month reserved) — estimated $Xk/month; 3) Private on-prem eval (time-and-materials for on-site setup). I'll draft a table. Need target ARR to propose discounts.
Taylor (Sales): Orion's target is mid-seven figures if POC successful. They asked about enterprise discount tiers and committed capacity pricing. Sam: recommend a 20% entry discount for first-year committed Dedicated.
Sam (Pricing): noted. I'll include a sample T&Cs bullet: minimum 3-month reserved commitment for Dedicated trial to get discounted rates.
Alex (SE): Collating matrix now — will include columns: Feature, Hosted, Dedicated, Private, Notes. Will add row for KMS type, HSM support, data residency, audit logs, latency SLO, and model pinning/versioning.
Priya (Security): For the questionnaire, I'm drafting short answers. Example: 'Do you support customer-managed keys?' -> 'Yes, for Dedicated and Private; Hosted supports CMEK in select regions; on-prem HSM supported via Private package.'
Alex (SE): Can someone confirm retention periods for audit logs? Needs to be specific in RFI.
Priya (Security): Default: 90 days in Hosted by default, configurable up to 365 days on Dedicated/Private with enterprise add-on. We'll call out the extra cost for long-term retention.
Taylor (Sales): Orion also asked about SLA for failover across regions and fallback to cheaper model variants. Is that documented?
Jordan (Product): Yes — routing policy supports region fallback and tiered model fallbacks. SLA depends on plan: Dedicated SLA covers inter-region failover for reservations; Hosted has best-effort cross-region fallback (we'll document: 99.9% regional availability for Hosted with fallback options).
InfraBot: Deploy bot: new draft matrix doc created: /internal/sales/rfis/orion-trust-framework/2026-03-matrix-v1.md
Alex (SE): Thanks InfraBot — I'll pull that doc and attach a PDF for the customer.
Priya (Security): Also attaching a redacted SOC2 cert reference and our compliance matrix link. Will mark fields that require legal sign-off.
Taylor (Sales): Timeline: need a draft response + matrix to send to customer by EOD tomorrow. POC SOW draft in 48 hours. Can everyone acknowledge?
Sam (Pricing): ack — I'll have pricing table + T&Cs in 48h.
Alex (SE): ack — matrix + technical answers by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Security): ack — security Q&A + compliance attachments by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (Product): ack — I'll add product caveats and the rollout plan section.
Taylor (Sales): Great. One more — Orion asked if we can include a short sample runbook for an on-prem HSM integration. Alex/Priya, can you add a 1-page runbook snippet?
Alex (SE): yes, will include: prerequisites, network ports, certs, validation steps, estimated time (2–4 weeks).
Priya (Security): I'll add the KMS/HSM checklist and key rotation notes.
Taylor (Sales): Perfect. I'll consolidate and send to Orion the next morning. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
